description: Agent Nonprofit Records: submit the annual report written for donors and the public with the records underneath it: the annual report with its reference, period, who it is written for, the currency, the donation total and number of gifts it states, the restricted-gift use it states, the board actions it discloses and each program result it states with the program and the figure; the records with each gift and its amount, each restricted-gift spending record and its amount, each program count record with the program and the count, and each board action recorded. The signed report gives the annual report and the records, the donation total and count against the gifts recorded, the restricted-gift use against the restricted spending recorded, each program result against the program counts added together, and the board actions disclosed against the actions recorded, and counts them, and names a divergent annual report: a donation total or count above what the gift records give, restricted-gift use stated unlike the restricted spending records, a program result above the program counts, and board actions the records hold and the annual report leaves out, smoothing the records into figures they do not support; then a figure stated below the records and a program result naming a program the counts do not hold, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No records, no donation figure beside gift records, no restricted-gift use beside restricted spending, or program results with no program counts leaves those points unverified. Gift amounts and restricted spending add to the cent, gifts and board actions count one per record, and program counts for one program add together with programs compared without case, accents or punctuation. This reads the public report the organization writes itself: wever_tax-filing-check reads a filing made to the government, while the annual report check reads the annual report written for donors and the public against the records underneath it. Verdict nonprofit_annual_report_divergent, nonprofit_annual_report_partial, nonprofit_annual_report_unverified or nonprofit_annual_report_consistent. POST /api/nonprofit-annual-report-check. Reads the nonprofit records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it solicits no donation, contacts no donor, files no form and gives no tax or legal advice, which stay with the organization and its advisers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Nonprofit Records reads a nonprofit’s own records: donation records, pledge records, restricted-gift records, fundraising campaign records, board and governance records, volunteer records, program spending records and the annual report written for donors and the public, each against the acknowledgment and ledger records, the collections, the spending records, the gift records and costs, the bylaws, votes and budgets, the shift records and policy, the mission and grant-purpose records or the records underneath it. The family’s ground is the nonprofit’s own house: money given, promises made by donors, restrictions placed on gifts, and what the board and the annual report say about all of it; the Agent Grants family reads the grant side, applications out and awards in, and the Agent Tax Records family reads filings made to the government, while this family reads neither. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-nonprofit-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-nonprofit-records/.
